output.summary: An erect annual herb, it may be native to Australia, the Americas, or both. It has dark green leaves, pale yellow five-sided flowers and yellow-orange fruits enclosed in balloon-like husks. Ripe fruits are eaten raw and the fruit may also be cooked or made into jam, but unripe raw fruits and all other parts are poisonous.
output.edibilityNote: Ripe fruits are traditionally eaten raw by Toba-Pilagá people; fruit may also be cooked or made into jam. Unripe raw fruits and other parts are poisonous.
